@@U02371@@
—It whizzed past my hair! —I felt it on my feet! —None of us are hurt. —But we've all had a fright. —The fun’s over. —lIt’s what they wanted, the beasts!

@@U02373@@
Long the herald of your masquerades, I’ve stood at the gate and never failed to keep from the hall any evil to disturb your revels. But now, I fear, airborne spirits are surging through every window, and I know nothing to save you from ghosts or sorcery. The dwarf was suspicious enough, but now at the back there’s a mighty onrush of figures whose meaning I'd like to expound, except I know nothing about them, and I ask your help. There! Look! Swerving through the crowd a glorious four-spanned coach, though it clears no path, no one makes way, no one pushes or shoves to get back. And there, far off, stars, glittering, rising, many-colored, shining, shifting, like a magic-lantern aglow, and on it comes snorting like a mighty storm. Make way! I shudder to see it!

@@U02375@@
Halt, my coursers! Slow, there, slow down!
translation:
@@U02371@@
——它从我的头发上呼啸而过！ ——我在脚上感觉到了！ ——我们没有人受伤。 ——但我们都曾害怕过。 ——乐趣结束了。 ——这就是他们想要的，野兽们！

@@U02373@@
长期以来，我一直是你们化装舞会的先驱，一直站在门口，从未阻止任何扰乱你们狂欢的邪恶事物进入大厅。但现在，我担心，空气中的灵魂正从每扇窗户涌入，我不知道什么可以把你从鬼魂或巫术中拯救出来。矮人已经够可疑的了，但现在后面有一大堆人影涌来，我想解释一下它们的含义，但我对它们一无所知，我请求你的帮助。那里！看！一辆辉煌的四跨马车在人群中转弯，尽管它没有开辟道路，没有人让路，没有人推或推回去。远处，星星闪闪发光，冉冉升起，色彩斑斓，闪闪发光，移动着，像一盏神奇的灯笼在发光，然后像一场强大的风暴一样喷着鼻息。让路！看到它我不寒而栗！

@@U02375@@
停下来，我的赛马们！慢点，那里，慢点！
